description: This file defines the WorkspaceListBuilder class for building and rendering a list of workspace entities in Drupal, including methods for loading data, building headers and rows, managing operations, and rendering the list with AJAX support.

classes.name: Drupal\workspaces_ui\WorkspaceListBuilder
classes.description: A class to build and render a list of workspace entities with AJAX support in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the WorkspaceListBuilder with necessary services.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of WorkspaceListBuilder using dependency injection.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads workspace entities, sorts them in tree order, and attaches depth information.

methods.name: getEntityListQuery
methods.description: Builds a query to list workspaces, filtering by default provider.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the workspace list table.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given workspace entity, including label, owner, and active status.

methods.name: getDefaultOperations
methods.description: Defines default operations (edit, activate, publish, merge, manage) for each workspace entity.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the workspace list, adding AJAX support and a switch-to-Live row.

methods.name: offCanvasRender
methods.description: Renders off-canvas UI elements for workspace management, including active workspace info and workspace list.
